runtime: UE 5.7.4 Development Win64 package, actual integrated AGIS/Hyper room, D3D11, sound disabled
regression: Current package build succeeds; m1-rejection-unreal-tests.log reports 39/39 native tests passed (38 clean, one with retained vendor tag warnings), zero failed/unrun.

partial_progress.verified: New campaign saves one battery in storage with the fuse still recoverable and radio inspected/unrepaired. Fresh process matches campaign ID and entire AGIS payload including two receipts, then retrieves battery, collects fuse, repairs and explicitly acknowledges, saves and quits with five receipts.

write_failure.fault: Both existing disposable test-slot files temporarily made read-only through the actual platform filesystem after backup; real UI Save is invoked.
write_failure.verified: DiskFailure notice, unchanged generation, both files byte-identical, actual AGIS payload unchanged, no recovery poison. Attributes restored; next UI Save succeeds and the game quits cleanly.
write_failure.cleanup: Both test files independently confirmed writable after process exit. External finally cleanup backs up normal in-probe cleanup.

corrupt_slot_recovery.fault: Exclusive new copied test pairs; one payload bit flipped in A or B respectively, producing a verified outer checksum mismatch. Source saves untouched.
corrupt_slot_recovery.verified: Real recovered-previous notice, same campaign, repaired/acknowledged mission and five receipts; valid counterpart's SHA-256 unchanged after each process.

invalid_pair_refusal.fault: Exclusive copied pairs with both payload checksums broken, or unsupported envelope version 2 in A/B with the other slot valid.
invalid_pair_refusal.verified: Presented Continue is available by design. Direct real coordinator Load returns InvalidSnapshot or Incompatible; New in the existing namespace also refuses. Campaign ID, generation, epoch, actual AGIS payload, journal, mission/world state, player transform and all six fixture files remain unchanged; no active campaign or recovery poison. Clean UI quit follows.
invalid_pair_refusal.scope: Actual packaged coordinator-boundary test with UI presence checks; does not claim controller navigation or UI-click error presentation. Initial failed runs incorrectly expected Continue to be disabled and are preserved.

limitations: Uses painted enabled widget commands and real Enhanced Input with deterministic positioning; not physical-controller traversal
Read-only refusal does not prove disk-full, partial-write, process-kill or rollback-failure behavior
Unsupported envelope refusal does not establish every provider/payload schema migration case
evidence_boundary: Full logs, screenshots, original and modified saves, payload fixtures and hashes remain external local evidence. Historical delivered evidence is unchanged.
